scope_note: Scope: these verdicts cover this project's accounts only. A purchase by your spouse or common-law partner, or by a corporation you or they control (affiliated persons, ITA s.251.1), within 30 days before or after a loss sale also makes it superficial — those accounts are not in the project, so check them yourself.

sections.title: VIOLATION — superficial loss; act to rescue the loss
LOCKED — recent buy; do not sell at a loss
EXITABLE — loss OK only if you exit the FULL position
CAUTION — recent buy, but the buyer has since sold out
RISK — sellable now; sheltered still holds (pause DRIPs 30 days after selling)
CLEAR — safe to sell at a loss
